title: Chore Wars Tournament
topicTag: Household chores · make / do · have to

questions.text:
Before dinner you put the plates, glasses, knives and forks on the table.

**___ the table**

After dinner you take the dirty plates and glasses off the table.

**___ the table**

You use a hot iron to make your shirts and T-shirts smooth.

**do the ___**

You clean the floor and the carpets with a noisy machine.

**do the ___**

Dirty plates, glasses and pans in the sink? Wash them!

**do the ___**

In the morning you put the sheets and the pillow in order.

**___ my bed**

The bin in the kitchen is full. Take it outside!

**___ the rubbish out**

Your cat is hungry. Give it its food.

**___ the cat**

Choose the verbs, in order:

**___ the ironing · ___ my bed · ___ the rubbish out**

Choose the verbs, in order:

**___ the vacuuming · ___ my room · ___ the dog**

Choose the verbs, in order:

**___ the washing · ___ dinner · ___ the cat**

Choose the verbs, in order:

**___ my bed · ___ the washing-up · ___ the table**

Mum: Look at your room! It's a mess!

**You have to ___ it now!**

Jen: My brother never helps at home.

**He never ___ his bed!**

Ben: My sister helps with the clothes.

**She ___ the ironing on Saturdays.**

Gran: Lunch is ready!

**Can you ___ the table, please?**
